name: fix-in-large-code
description: A bug fix in about 2,000 lines of code, where doing the work yourself costs real context: the master's peak context, reported per arm, should stay near its starting size while the work is done and recorded.

prompt.with: /quest-master Work on the nested-clone-snapshot quest: do step 1.
prompt.without: Work on the nested-clone-snapshot quest: do step 1.

graders.name: fixed
graders.run: set -e; q=$(mktemp -d)/quests/sample; mkdir -p $q/research/vendor/pdfkit; echo '# Sample' > $q/QUEST.md; git -C $q/research/vendor/pdfkit init -q; echo x > $q/research/vendor/pdfkit/lib.py; git -C $q/research/vendor/pdfkit add -A; git -C $q/research/vendor/pdfkit commit -qm lib; python3 quests/nested-clone-snapshot/worktrees/1/bin/quest snapshot $q; ! git -C $q ls-files --stage | grep -q '^160000'

graders.name: tests-pass
graders.run: cd quests/nested-clone-snapshot/worktrees/1 && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests 2>&1 | tail -3 | grep -q '^OK'

graders.name: test-added
graders.run: git -C quests/nested-clone-snapshot/worktrees/1 diff -- tests | grep -q '^+ *def test'

graders.name: record-updated
graders.criteria: Current State says the snapshot bug is fixed in worktrees/1, names its cause (nested repositories were only found near the top of the quest, not at any depth), and says a test covers it.
